subject: Invoice origin + distribution: portal preferred but need email copy and VAT line
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 7 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice origin + distribution decision for Acme (PO 87421)

Quick context: Acme's AP (Sara) replied that they want invoices available in their portal first, but they require a PDF copy via email to the bill-to contact for each invoice and a separate VAT line on the invoice. They also need the PO number to be on line 1.

Options we need to pick between for this account:
- Invoice creator: Redwood (our system emits PDF + portal push) vs Partner billing connector (3rd-party billing provider emits)
- Delivery channel: push to Acme portal (primary) + email copy to bill-to OR portal-only (they will not accept portal-only)
- VAT handling: single-line VAT or separate tax line item per invoice (they explicitly asked for separate line)

Ask: Kimberly/Connor — can you confirm whether we can: (1) set Redwood as invoice originator (easier for remittance reconciliation), (2) enable portal push + email copy to bill-to, and (3) add a VAT-line mapping to the UBL/XML we send? If we can't do (1), we need to coordinate with partner for signed authorization. I pasted Acme's email below.

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the update. Confirming AP preferences:
- We'd like the invoice to land in our portal (preferred).
- Please also send a PDF copy to billing@acme-corp.com and to the bill-to contact (billing contact: ap.team@acme-corp.com).
- The invoice must include PO 87421 on the main header and must show VAT as a separate line with VAT percentage and amount.
- Please also include a remit-to note in the PDF describing bank details (we accept wire/ACH).

If Redwood needs to be the emitter/originator for the portal push to be accepted, please let me know; otherwise we can accept push from the partner connector if you have delegated that.

Regards,

Subject: Re: Invoice origin + distribution decision for Acme (PO 87421)

Thanks — quick notes from the billing team after reviewing Acme's requirements: 
- Redwood can emit the UBL/XML with a separate tax block for VAT, and we can include the PO at the top-level element.
- Portal push: our connector expects the invoice emitter ID to match the registered sender. If Redwood is the originator that's easiest. If the partner is the emitter, we need a signed authorization letter from Acme or a formal delegate recorded in their portal settings.
- Email copy: we can automatically fan out a PDF to multiple addresses on send (billing@ + bill-to). There's a small per-message postage cost but it's covered under the current onboarding credit.

I'm attaching an XML sample of the payload we would send and a PDF template we would generate.

Attachments: invoice-sample-ubl.xml

Kimberly
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations

-----Original Message-----
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lund <sara.lund@acme-corp.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Invoice origin + distribution decision for Acme (PO 87421)

Perfect — thanks, all. Final plan we will follow: 
1) Redwood will be the invoice originator for Acme (no partner emitter).
2) We will push the invoice to Acme's portal as primary delivery and simultaneously send a PDF copy to billing@acme-corp.com and ap.team@acme-corp.com.
3) Billing ops (Kimberly) will ensure the UBL includes a separate VAT tax block and the PO in header. Please use the attached XML sample as the canonical mapping.
4) Connor — please update HubSpot with emitter=Redwood and attach Acme's signed PO (I added the PO we have on file as acme-po-87421.pdf).

Kimberly: next steps on your side: confirm ETA for first live push (we're aiming EOD next Thursday) and let me know if you need a signed authorization from Acme for any portal settings.

Sara: once we've done the first live invoice push I'll CC you on the delivery receipts and the PDF copy. If anything else is required on the format (VAT breakout, remit-to language), we'll iterate quickly — thanks for the clear specs.

Best,
Hannah
